gates.prompt: For each repo in {{repos}}, verify that these files exist at the repository root: README.md, CHANGELOG.md, LICENSE, .gitignore. Exclude venv/ node_modules/ __pycache__ .git from any filesystem traversal. For each repo, return: { repo: string, missing_files: string[], status: "ok" | "missing" }. If any file is missing, flag status as "missing" and list which ones.

Check version consistency across the repos in {{repos}}. For each repo that contains a blueprint.json, compare its top-level version field against the corresponding entry in catalog.json. A mismatch means the catalog entry is out of sync with the blueprint source. Exclude venv/ node_modules/ __pycache__ .git from any search. Return: { mismatches: [{repo: string, blueprint_version: string, catalog_version: string}], status: "ok" | "mismatch" }

Scan the repos in {{repos}} for private or sensitive content that must not appear in a public OSS push. Check for: hardcoded private IP addresses (e.g. 192.168.x.x, 10.x.x.x, 100.x.x.x Tailscale ranges), internal reference identifiers, session reference numbers, the extra patterns in {{scrub_patterns}}. Exclude venv/ node_modules/ __pycache__ .git from grep. For each match, report: { repo: string, file: string, line: number, pattern: string, snippet: string }. Return: { leaks: [...], status: "clean" | "leaked" }
